%struct.PacketCtx = type { ptr, ptr, i32, ptr, ptr }
define i32 @route_packet_frame(ptr noundef %ctx, ptr noundef %net_payload) #0 {
entry:
  %retval = alloca i32, align 4
  %ctx.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  %net_payload.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  %fn = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %ctx, ptr %ctx.addr, align 8
  store ptr %net_payload, ptr %net_payload.addr, align 8
  %0 = load ptr, ptr %ctx.addr, align 8
  %channel_id = getelementptr inbounds nuw %struct.PacketCtx, ptr %0, i32 0, i32 2
  %1 = load i32, ptr %channel_id, align 8
  %cmp = icmp eq i32 %1, 0
  br i1 %cmp, label %if.then, label %if.end
if.then:                                          ; preds = %entry
  store i32 -1, ptr %retval, align 4
  br label %return
if.end:                                           ; preds = %entry
  %2 = load ptr, ptr %net_payload.addr, align 8
  %3 = load ptr, ptr %ctx.addr, align 8
  %untrusted_cmd = getelementptr inbounds nuw %struct.PacketCtx, ptr %3, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %2, ptr %untrusted_cmd, align 8
  %4 = load ptr, ptr %ctx.addr, align 8
  %session_buf = getelementptr inbounds nuw %struct.PacketCtx, ptr %4, i32 0, i32 4
